name: Short Cut Steak, Bell Pepper & Bombay Potato Curry with Naan

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; slice lengthwise into thin strips.

Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, beef, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until bell pepper is just tender and beef is almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
8 oz beef strips for stir-fry
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add Bombay potatoes and chickpeas to the skillet with the beef and bell pepper; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (10 oz) pkg Bombay potatoes & chickpeas, ready-to-eat

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, toast naan if desired, then cut into quarters. Wash, dry, and cut lime into wedges.
To serve, divide beef curry and naan between bowls. Squeeze lime over top and enjoy!
